checks.check: Recovery regression uses isolated storage
Professional preparation configures before its storage path becomes available
An initial load failure exposes a retryable state
An unavailable initial profile has no invented progress or playable round
Restore the initial storage path
The initial load retry stays busy while recovery is pending
Successful recovery without an active round returns Home to idle
Recovery loads the profile without pretending a course is already prepared
An idle recovered profile still requires a real round source
Remove the isolated recovery fixture
Request respects request from the earliest session notification
Request respects cancel from the earliest session notification
Request respects leave from the earliest session notification
Request freezes only supported context fields before the first callback
Loader callback request cannot be overwritten by the outer request return
Loader callback cancel cannot be overwritten by the outer request return
Loader callback leave cannot be overwritten by the outer request return
Nested request keeps its state after cancel session notification
Nested request keeps its state after leave session notification
Restoring an active round cannot overwrite a nested newer request
Pending cancellation preserves the active claimed Access lease
Controller teardown releases that active Access lease exactly once
Ready notification request suppresses the obsolete round_prepared event
Ready notification cancel suppresses the obsolete round_prepared event
Ready notification leave suppresses the obsolete round_prepared event
Opening callback request discards the obsolete storage result
Opening callback cancel discards the obsolete storage result
Opening callback leave discards the obsolete storage result
Retry preserves a nested selection from the retry notification
Retry preserves a nested selection from the leave notification
An unchanged current opening still publishes its original selection and source

scope: Actual ProfessionalPlay controller with controlled lifecycle callbacks, actual Access registry, and retained real initial-storage recovery test; no domain integration or acceptance.
